scores.basis: Distinct indigo/crimson costume and long covered sword silhouette; sampled floor clearance; optional support and palm/guard recheck.
Bare native hair/face readable, black/crimson costume and hip knife preserved; sheath partly occluded by hand/sash.
Oxblood/gold blocks, unobscured face and hanging hammer readable; optional belt suspension.
Hair/eyes exposed and pack removed; full bow curve visible from back/angled views, side stand-off remains optional polish.
Ngob/river-worker costume and large blade recognizable; carried paddle clears hat in inspected multi-view samples, stationary blade stays at floor; face shaded by brim.

scoreLimits: Art Bible >=8/10 targets applied to bounded costume/tool presentation at body scale. Technical score is sampled visible usability, not continuous collision clearance, planted feet, skin strain, grasp, seating or runtime performance.

findings.title: Hunter cap obscured brow/eyes
findings.resolution: The bulbous clothHat is absent. Native hair, forehead and eyes are visible in inspected front, side, talk/idle three-quarter and prop-front views.

findings.title: Bandit raised headband
findings.resolution: The floating red ring and raised tails are absent in front/back/side, talk, lean and walking samples; native crown silhouette remains.

findings.title: Hunter pack obscured bow and floated behind torso
findings.resolution: The rectangular pack is absent, eliminating that object's gap and occlusion. The bow's continuous curve is visible across the back and beside the torso in angled views. Edge-on bow remains rod-like and has a visible stand-off without a bridging strap: optional suspension polish, not a claim of physical support.

findings.title: Moving paddle intersected ngob brim
findings.resolution: The upper shaft visibly projects outside the wide brim in front/back/three-quarter walking captures. Side samples at 0.5 and 0.75 s show a close approach at the rear brim, with no shaft emerging through the straw surface. Stationary blade remains parked at the floor; moving blade clears it. Closure rests on actual pixels, not the prior numeric fixture.
findings.limits: Sampled views do not certify a full-cycle minimum clearance. Hat still hides eyes in front/overhead views; retain existing optional dialogue readability note.

findings.title: Enhancer lifted procedural headband
findings.resolution: The raised forward procedural band/ends are absent in inspected angled, side and walking views. The remaining red detail follows the original head/hair silhouette; no replacement or baked-headband provenance is inferred.

findings.title: Make stowed tool suspension legible
findings.observation: Visible sash-to-sheath/hammer loops and back-tool lashings are absent or unreadable. Bow has a noticeable side gap. Sword guard is close to the relaxed hand; view occlusion cannot prove full 3D clearance. No actual skin penetration is established by these samples.
findings.action: Optional later small tie/loop from existing sash or back strap to retained tool; preserve source body, open hands, tool scale and stow placement. If undertaken, recapture side/back/hand closeups. Do not promote this advisory to P2 or invent gripping.
